title: Annual capture histories of 2922 great tits ringed at nest boxes and mist-net sites along an urban gradient, Glasgow to Loch Lomond, 2019-2023
creator: Dominoni, D.M.; Capilla-Lasheras, P.; Branston, C.J.
citation: Dominoni, D.M.; Capilla-Lasheras, P.; Branston, C.J. (2024). Mark-recapture data of individual birds from ringing records, Glasgow, UK, 2014-2022. NERC EDS Environmental Information Data Centre. https://doi.org/10.5285/9982cf52-7144-4877-9e17-1335f14140d8. Contains data supplied by UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology.
abstract: Ringing records of great tits from nest-box populations (adults caught on the nest, nestlings ringed at 13 days) and opportunistic mist netting at 21-27 sites a year along a 35 km urban-to-rural gradient from Glasgow city centre to Loch Lomond, Scotland, collapsed to annual capture histories for survival analysis.
samplingProtocol: Nest boxes monitored 1 April-20 June each year; breeding adults caught on the nest 2-10 days after hatching and nestlings ringed at 13 days with BTO metal rings; opportunistic mist netting outside the breeding season; captures pooled to one annual occasion.
geographicCoverage: Glasgow city centre to Loch Lomond and the Trossachs National Park, Scotland, UK (site names only, no coordinates)
covariateNote: cluster_id: site of first capture. unit_first_age: BTO age code at first capture (1 nestling, X nestling that died in the nest, 3/3J juvenile, 4-6 adult). unit_sex: most frequent M/F recorded, else U. obs_found_dead: 1 if the bird was found dead that year. obs_removed: 1 on the last row of a bird that died in the nest or was found dead.

notShipped.no_ring: 355 records (both species) whose ring_number is a note ('too small', 'unringed', ...) or blank
notShipped.dead_only: birds known only from a dead recovery (never caught alive): not units (E4.4)
notShipped.within_year: capture dates, times, biometrics, nest box, parents, RFID and colour rings (one annual occasion is shipped)

notes: The deposit holds 2019-2023 although its title says 2014-2022. Sites with records per year (in __periods) vary from 19 to 23, so detection varies by year. Nestlings have rows from their ringing year, other birds from 2019 (E4.4).
